quests.title: Monday Starts at 001
quests.blurb: Forty-one years of dockets. Sunday I finish on a big number. Monday the book starts at 001 and nobody in this plaza thinks that is strange except me. Look at a few things for me before you go home.

steps.label: stand at the John Street noticeboard and read the flyers: same three, corners curled the same way
order a flat white in Cabramatta. One place makes them, for the council people, and the machine is under a tea towel
the plaza car park has four people who film you reversing. Discourage all four
photograph the specials board at Canley Vale. Compare it to Tuesday's photograph. It will be the same photograph
go the way the money goes: up the line to Liverpool
her cousin's counter, off the Liverpool mall. Look at his book, do not touch his book
put three hundred through your own week and see whether the number stays where you left it
back to the counter with all of it

quests.title: No Grounds Required
quests.blurb: Forty-one years in flat 3. Then the metro opened, the rent found out, and the notice arrived with no reason on it, because it does not have to have one. I would like the reason written down somewhere. Anywhere will do.

steps.label: photograph the bathroom ceiling in flat 3. The condition report calls it surface discolouration consistent with age.
find the emergency plumber. He has been on his way since March and it turns out there are six of him.
get to the 11:15 open home on Willoughby Road. Two hundred metres from Nola's kitchen, eight hundred and ninety a week.
thin the queue. Twelve applicants, twelve cover letters, every one of them loves the area and will treat it as their own.
six fifty for a flat white on Willoughby Road. Two and a bit hours of the increase, if you spread the increase across the week, which is how Nola has started thinking.
ride the metro one stop to Victoria Cross. Three minutes under the harbour. That is the entire argument, and it cost her the flat.
raise $470 in a day: the difference between what flat 3 cost in March and what flat 3 is advertised for now.
take the lot back to Nola and help her fill in section four.

quests.title: Be More Interesting Than Me
quests.blurb: Seventeen dollars thirty-four to walk through a gate. My people don't pay it. But tonight there's a car parked on my footpath, so go and be more interesting than me for twenty minutes.

steps.label: the kerb outside international, where the walk starts and the fares don't
ten a head, up the road, twelve of them — minus the two who saw the towers and got a taxi
plaza level, under the good lighting: give Discovery Point something to discover
the breath test bus is parked across the end of his walk. Persuade the crew to test somebody else
photograph it. Sione keeps a file. The file goes nowhere and he keeps it anyway
one stop. One river. A platform nobody can drive a car onto
walk back at shift change and let him count what it bought

quests.title: Someone Has to Catch the 7:12
quests.blurb: Thirty-one years on the 7:12 and my wife can see every tap of it on the statement. Today I need to be on a train going the other way. Take my card. Have an ordinary Tuesday on my behalf.

steps.label: down the line to Wynyard, tapped on at Pymble like every other morning of his life
8:04. One flat white. The same order for eleven years and he has never once changed it
photograph the lobby of the building he does not work in — the group chat expects a Tuesday
put two hundred through the day, so that one number on the statement is honestly earned
the 5:41 has four blokes on it who started at three, and one of them is on the phone in the quiet carriage
home, tapped off at Pymble at 6:04, exactly where thirty-one years of statements say you will be
give the man his card back on the up platform

quests.title: The Wagon's in the Breath Test Queue
quests.blurb: Someone took the wagon off King Street with the whole PA in the back. It's alive, it's standing at an RBT on the Princes Highway, and the constable wants to keep it till Monday. I've got a Saturday gig.

steps.label: take the spare key off Gail — it lives in the till, taped to a coaster from the old pub
photograph the empty spot outside the pub for the insurer, who values the car at ninety dollars
get the release fee together — two hundred and sixty, cash, no card facility, obviously
train it down to St Peters, because the car you'd have driven is the car you're going to collect
find the breath test bus on the Princes Highway: cones out, everybody sober and furious
two locals are livestreaming the RBT to the Newtown community page. The wagon does not need the exposure
explain to the wand crew, at length, that a blue Corolla is not a witness
dawn on the Princes Highway, a manual with no clutch left, and all of King Street between you and the pub

quests.title: Ocean Glimpse, From One Particular Square Metre
quests.blurb: The listing says Coogee. The letterbox says Randwick. The glimpse is one square metre of the back deck and I can't be seen within four hundred of it. Auction Saturday. Monday next door pours a pergola. Photograph it while it exists.

steps.label: a flat white at the Spot. You're a buyer's agent this morning: hold it, don't drink it.
the glimpse. One square metre of back deck, over next door's roofline. Stand wrong and it's a carport.
four neighbours will come out to ask who you are. This street has photographed every tradesman since 2011.
Randwick to Kingsford on the tram. Don't walk Anzac Parade in this heat, you'll photograph like a hostage.
the rival's board on the corner: the price guide, the word COOGEE, and the fact that you're standing in Kingsford.
$200 of your own on the way. He can't pay you until settlement, and settlement is a concept.
back to the terminus and give him the paddle count

quests.title: Nobody Round Here Has a Job
quests.blurb: Everyone in this postcode has a business. Nobody in this postcode has a job. The juniors need eleven hundred by Sunday for jerseys, and I have got a tin, a barbecue and you. Bring the tin back heavier.

steps.label: Caringbah, the wholesaler. Sausages on the club account, settled fortnightly since 1981.
collect the five blokes who said 'yeah for sure' in March and have been at a seminar in Miranda ever since
get the barbecue onto the grass at Woolooware before the juniors kick off
three hundred and twenty dollars, one sausage at a time. This is the hard way. There is no other way.
two flat whites off the Kingsway. She reimburses you exactly, in fifty cent pieces, counted twice
photograph the train unloading at the last stop on the line — the council grant form calls it 'evidence of visitation'
the last bank branch in the Shire is at Sutherland and it shuts at four. Bank run.
sit down while Doris reads the day back to you, line by line

quests.title: Colour and Movement, Six Episodes
quests.blurb: A production company has taken the Westfield carpark for six episodes about how hard it is out here. They pay a hundred and twenty a driveway. Go and be authentic at them, then go and say it in Artarmon.

steps.label: the unit base is in the Westfield carpark: eleven vehicles, a marquee, and a bloke with a clipboard where the trolley bay was
film the film crew. They will ask what it's for. Do not tell them.
the production has flown out three community liaison consultants to consult with the community. Consult back.
a hundred and twenty a driveway is the going rate. Get a hundred and twenty out of the day off somebody who isn't them.
the broadcaster sits in Artarmon. In 2015 the boys did this run with forty trucks. You've got an Opal card.
photograph the front doors and the visitor parking. That is the right of reply, delivered in full.
get back out west and tell Ronnie what Artarmon looks like

quests.title: Statistically Valid Community Consultation
quests.blurb: Under forty submissions it isn't statistically valid and we run the whole thing again. This is the fourth one. I don't need you for or against. I need you to be forty people. There's a sausage sizzle and nobody's come.

steps.label: photograph the view from Lot 4 while it is still a view: the bay, the mangroves, and the sign about not eating the fish
doorknock the Rhodes Peninsula Residents' Action Group for eight submissions. They will not go quietly, and that is the point
acquit the sausage sizzle against the community engagement grant. One hundred and twenty dollars. Bread was not in the budget
two flat whites from the Waterside. One is for the acting director, who will not be attending
one stop across the river. The traffic study assumes everybody takes the train. Be an assumption
photograph the shadow where it actually lands. It lands in Ryde, so it is not our shadow, so it is not in the report
lodge the submissions at the only counter on the peninsula. The counter belongs to the applicant
stand there while Priya writes down forty

quests.title: The Doof Has a Two-Hour Loading Zone
quests.blurb: Six hundred people upstairs, one lead down the fire stairs, and my van's been in a two-hour zone since eleven. Nobody dances if the ranger comes back. Get me to four in the morning and you can have the good earplugs.

steps.label: get up to level six of the Burwood carpark and help walk the subs out of the lift
work the door in cash — the building wants its cut before the first drop
four noise complaints are coming up the fire stairs with the council app already open
half three: one flat white for the closing DJ, one for Kaz, from the bubble tea place that never shuts
photograph the queue folded down the laneway past Burwood Park — it is next month's flyer
put the last of them on the first train to Central before they try to drive
the dawn RBT has parked itself across the driveway and the van is behind it
find Kaz at the load-out and tell her the van is clear
